changeSet.author: HealthMesh
changeSet.comment: Retire duplicate non-Bahmni EMR API diagnosis metadata concepts when Bahmni canonical concepts exist
changeSet.sql: UPDATE concept c JOIN concept_reference_map rmap ON rmap.concept_id = c.concept_id JOIN concept_reference_term rterm ON rterm.concept_reference_term_id = rmap.concept_reference_term_id JOIN concept_reference_source rsource ON rsource.concept_source_id = rterm.concept_source_id JOIN concept_reference_map canonical_map ON canonical_map.concept_reference_term_id = rterm.concept_reference_term_id JOIN concept canonical_concept ON canonical_concept.concept_id = canonical_map.concept_id AND canonical_concept.retired = FALSE AND canonical_concept.version = 'BAHMNI-CORE-1.0' SET c.retired = TRUE, c.retired_by = 1, c.date_retired = NOW(), c.retire_reason = 'Retired duplicate EMR API metadata concept; Bahmni canonical concept exists' WHERE rsource.name = 'org.openmrs.module.emrapi' AND rterm.code IN ( 'Diagnosis Concept Set', 'Coded Diagnosis', 'Non-Coded Diagnosis', 'Diagnosis Certainty', 'Diagnosis Order' ) AND c.retired = FALSE AND c.concept_id <> canonical_concept.concept_id AND (c.version IS NULL OR c.version <> 'BAHMNI-CORE-1.0');
